description: hcm_data_healer DAG: one entry per campaign window to reconcile, recover and push daily at 02:00 UTC

tenant.description: central cluster: the tenant to heal, e.g. so (blank = TENANT_ID); single-tenant cluster: blank or TENANT_ID

campaignName.description: optional display label used in Slack; the window is identified by tenant + startDate + endDate

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD; blank = up to the settle cutoff (newest 3 days are never healed)

slackChannels.description: Slack channel ids for this window, comma separated, e.g. C0BDXCWCC3Z, C0ABC12345

active.description: YES = include in the daily run
